message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Deploy Docs to GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'e2e/**'
      - 'playwright.config.ts'
      - '.github/workflows/docs.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'e2e/**'
      - 'playwright.config.ts'
      - '.github/workflows/docs.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: 'pages'
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Check docs links
        uses: lycheeverse/lychee-action@v2
        with:
          args: >-
            --no-progress
            --verbose
            --accept 200,202,206,429
            --max-retries 2
            --retry-wait-time 2
            --timeout 20
            --root-dir docs
            --exclude-path changelog/README.md
            --exclude https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/1/4/code-of-conduct.html
            docs/**/*.md
            docs/index.html
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        run: npx playwright install chromium --with-deps

      - name: Run Playwright tests
        run: npx playwright test

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: playwright-report/
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload screenshots
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        with:
          name: docs-screenshots
          path: e2e/screenshots/
          retention-days: 30

  deploy:
    needs: test
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v6
        with:
          enablement: true

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v5
        with:
          path: docs

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v5",
  "rationale": "The test job has no explicit timeout, so a hung or runaway run can consume unbounded runner time. Evidence pattern P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT supports bounding jobs with a custom timeout, and the measured experiment (experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) showed adding timeout-minutes: 5 to a job preserved all successes (3/3) while reducing median elapsed time by ~26.8%. Repository CI history shows successful runs completing in under 3 minutes, so a 5-minute budget provides operational headroom without removing any build or test step. All existing steps, triggers, permissions, artifacts, and the deploy job are preserved unchanged.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]
}
